upstream_change: Original upstream PR 17 fixes 0xff versus EOF in examples/tail.c; ringbuffer.c/h and examples/Makefile do not change
migration: Actual ringbuffer implementation translation to checked Hepta then Rust C ABI library, with caller-authored existing record/view contracts
build_integration: Unmodified Makefile and C clients; CC wrapper substitutes the translated implementation library for exactly ringbuffer.c
timing: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW wall time for complete 128-transaction batches, including mutex wait for the shared profile
rss: Fresh C fork/exec supervisor uses wait4 child ru_maxrss, retaining supervisor and child pre-exec floors
recovery: Each invalid foreign call executes in its own child; parent waits for SIGABRT and performs a valid roundtrip after each fault
limitations: Small existing upstream C project and one actual upstream change, not a production C++ application
The maintained upstream change is in the original C caller; translated ringbuffer bodies do not change
Original public header inline helpers may remain inlined in unchanged C clients; dynamic host qualification calls all nine exported migrated functions
NDEBUG unsigned-char implementation capture is explicit; valid original signed-char C clients are empirically qualified on x86_64 SysV only
Caller guarantees foreign pointer readability, extent, lifetime, and synchronization
Separate records or an external pthread mutex; no lock-free shared ownership or race proof
Shared nonexclusive Linux x86_64 host; descriptive batch-tail and RSS samples, no speedup gate
No AArch64, RISC-V, GPU, MMIO, DMA, ISR, WCET or physical-device observation
Machine wall/CPU stages measured; human authoring/review/maintenance hours remain unknown
